extracted.intended_audience: Federal information managers, Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs (OIRA)/OMB staff, and federal agencies implementing OMB Circular A-130
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and evaluative criteria for Federal scientific and technical information management under OMB Circular A-130, including recommended actions agencies and OMB/OIRA should take to improve information life-cycle planning, integrity, access, interoperability, and interagency cooperation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarify life-cycle planning for information useability
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify 'life-cycle planning' for information useability so agencies plan and manage scientific and technical information throughout its life cycle to ensure continued usability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report recommends that OMB/OIRA clarify what is meant by life-cycle planning in Circular A-130 to facilitate more effective information management; agencies should adopt life-cycle planning practices that support long-term usability of information assets (acquisition, maintenance, preservation, dissemination).

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop guidelines to ensure information integrity for the public good
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop guidance or standards to ensure the integrity of agency-held scientific and technical information so it remains accurate, reliable, and trustworthy for public use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should follow guidelines that preserve information authenticity, prevent unauthorized modification or loss, and support the public interest; OMB should issue clearer guidance on protections and practices that uphold information integrity as part of A-130 implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarify guidance concerning public access to agency information
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify Circular A-130 guidance on public access so agencies have clear direction on what information should be made available to the public and how access should be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The recommendation calls for OMB to refine instructions about public access to agency information (including scientific and technical material), addressing what is required, exceptions, and practical mechanisms for providing access consistent with law and policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resolve conflicts between A-130 objectives and other Government initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify and reconcile conflicts between the objectives of Circular A-130 and other government initiatives or programs to avoid contradictory requirements and implementation problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies and OMB should examine overlapping policies and initiatives, resolve inconsistencies, and harmonize objectives to enable coherent information management practices; the report recommends OMB facilitate this resolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor development of a selected mode of operation for Government information services
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor an effort to select or develop a preferred mode of operation for Government information services to promote consistency and efficiency in how information services are delivered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report suggests OMB should sponsor an initiative to define a selected mode(s) of operation (e.g., centralized vs. distributed services, standards for delivery platforms) so agencies can coordinate implementation and reduce duplication or fragmentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutionalize interagency cooperative efforts for information sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutionalize interagency cooperation and mechanisms for sharing scientific and technical information across Federal organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish formal interagency structures, agreements, or processes to enable routine information sharing and collaboration; institutionalization is intended to sustain cooperative efforts beyond ad hoc arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a template agencies can use to measure progress toward A-130 objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Supply a measurement template that Federal agencies can use to assess their progress toward meeting the objectives of Circular A-130.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report includes (or recommends) a template and summary of agency practices to enable agencies to evaluate and document implementation status and improvements; agencies should use such tools to track compliance, identify gaps, and guide corrective actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summarize and assess agency practices against A-130 objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Document and evaluate current agency practices in scientific and technical information management to determine how well they align with A-130 objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The study compiled summaries of agency practices as a baseline for assessment; agencies should be assessed on whether their policies, procedures, and operations support the Circular's goals (life-cycle planning, integrity, access, interoperability, and cooperative sharing).
